examples.text: In principle, resection of liver metastases is indicated when an extrahepatic recidivous occurrence or a second tumour is excluded.

glosses: present participle and gerund of recur
Happening or occurring frequently, with repetition.

examples.text: Revenge is a recurring theme in this novel.

glosses: Of a decimal: having a set of digits that is repeated indefinitely.

examples.text: Every rational number can be written as either a terminating decimal or a recurring decimal.

glosses: A recurrence; a coming round again.

examples.text: Winter, here, is a dimension of all reality, not one-fourth of the spiritual year's endless recurrings.
